title: Kissed Smoky Greek Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Greek lamb stew featuring ancho chillies and a char-grill yang, served in a scallop shell, this dish is perfect for a cold winter night. The mustardy and pillowy texture will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the ancho chillies, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the mustard and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the stew in scallop shells, garnished with fresh parsley or dill.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
